reviews.reviewer: Claude Sonnet (independent, claude -p --model sonnet, read-only plan review)
blocking: toon material inputs (emission, alpha, normals, shadows, billboards) unspecified
'bridge mesh' defined by a position hack
retiring the key changes existing star-light assertions; level switch unspecified
S4 fonts and the 9-slice border have no authoring, pin or licence step
reviews.resolution: All folded in 2026-10-20: shader spec with exclusions and next_pass exactly the ink; membership by the bridge_style group and manifest style.bridge_nodes; the three changing key checks listed and the level switch defined; the spire's shadow opacity follows the key's ramp with boundary tests; fonts (OFL, pinned) and a seeded ink border tool; deck/spire at 1024^2 (~28 MB) with a runtime-compression fallback; 1,300 LOC over 8.5 days, ST5 split into ST5 dressing and ST6 landing, ST3 2 days; ui-theme-check covers ui/ and the demo HUD with explicit allow-lists. Suggestions taken: named sky layers in AC3, the SubViewport note, a slide flicker bound, the AC9 rerun rule, a dressing negative control, below-rail outside lower decks, the mock tool committed as review-only, OQ3's default recorded at approval, the D-96 framing hook, S4 as a separable PR.
